messages:
Anna (Support): Hey team, incoming from acct 'AcmeAnalytics' — their Token Cost dashboard is showing $0 or NaN for several sub-orgs since the nightly ETL. Customer ticket #CA-4821, screenshot attached. They say it started around 02:15 UTC yesterday. Can data/backend look?

Jordan Barnes: Thanks Anna. Can you paste quick repro steps and a sample org id that shows the issue? Also, any recent deploys to metrics/etl?

Anna (Support): Repro steps I used: 1) Login to console -> Billing -> Token Cost. 2) Apply org filter -> select "AcmeAnalytics" -> switch to 7d view -> some rows show "$0.00" and others show "NaN" on sparkline. Affected sub-org ids: 67321, 67322, 67389. No deploys from support side; ops mentioned a nightly transform v2.1 landed yesterday.

Maria (Data Eng): Looking into the backfill logs now. Quick check: I ran the ledger join for org 67321 in staging:

```
SELECT l.org_id, SUM(t.tokens_cost) AS cost
FROM `prod.ledger.events` l
LEFT JOIN `prod.billing.token_costs` t
  ON l.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE l.org_id = '67321'
GROUP BY 1;
```

Result: cost is NULL for multiple days. Seems the join didn't match. I'm seeing account_id on ledger as STRING but token_costs.account_id is INT in some partitions — looks like a schema drift.

Kai (Backend): Ugh. That would explain NaNs in the aggregates: frontend displays NaN when cost agg is NULL. Two things: 1) the metrics cache layer stores daily aggregates — if the underlying table had NULLs cached, the UI shows zeros/NaN until cache expires. 2) We had a deploy to metrics-calc at 01:50 UTC yesterday that changed partitioning logic.

MetricsBot: Backfill job token_costs_backfill for orgs [67321,67322,67389] started at 2024-11-03T03:30:12Z and failed: ERROR: Type mismatch in JOIN on account_id.

Maria (Data Eng): Confirmed. The nightly transform coerced account_id to INT when sourcing from some legacy pipelines; other sources still emit STRING. I can patch the transform to CAST(account_id AS STRING) in the token_costs extraction and run a targeted backfill. Would need permission to re-run the backfill for those orgs.

Jordan Barnes: Rough ETA to patch + backfill? Customer is asking for timeline. Severity P2? It's affecting billing visibility but not actual billing invoices (we think).

Maria (Data Eng): Patch: trivial (one-line cast). Backfill for 7 days for 3 orgs takes ~30m on our infra. Full 90-day backfill is ~3-4 hours. I'll target patch + 7-day backfill as hotfix first.

Kai (Backend): Before data backfill, I recommend invalidating metrics cache for those orgs to avoid showing stale zeros. Admin endpoint: POST https://console-internal.redwood/api/admin/cache/invalidate with body `{ "prefix": "token_costs:org:67321" }`. I can run that once Maria patches. Also I'll add frontend guard to show "No data" instead of NaN for null aggregates (quick fix).

Anna (Support): Noted. I'll reply to the customer: hotfix planned (patch + 7d backfill) ETA ~1 hour, full backfill if they want 90 days ~3-4 hours.

Maria (Data Eng): Patch deployed to staging. SQL change: `CAST(account_id AS STRING) AS account_id_str` and join on `account_id_str`. Triggering backfill via Airflow:

```
airflow dags trigger token_costs_backfill --conf '{"orgs": [67321,67322,67389], "days": 7}'
```

MetricsBot: Backfill job succeeded for 7d for orgs [67321,67322,67389] at 2024-11-03T04:12:05Z.

Kai (Backend): Cache invalidation complete for prefixes: token_costs:org:67321, token_costs:org:67322, token_costs:org:67389. Frontend guard merged to prod (shows "No data" instead of NaN).

Anna (Support): I pushed update to customer: hotfix completed, dashboard reflects corrected numbers for those sub-orgs, asked them to confirm. They replied :thumbsup: and said values look good. Marking ticket CA-4821 as resolved pending monitoring.

Jordan Barnes: Follow-ups: 1) Add schema validation in transform to block implicit type changes. 2) Add alert on high null-aggregate ratio for token_costs. 3) Schedule a full 90-day backfill overnight for all affected orgs if customer requests.

Maria (Data Eng): Agreed on validation + alert. I'll open a follow-up RFC for schema checks and add a datapipeline test.

Anna (Support): Closing loop here — thanks all. Will log postmortem with timeline and RCA after we collect metrics.
